cycle4_rules: authoritative stores/events commit before semantic epoch publication
failed/unknown projector validation leaves prior epoch current
old graph epochs remain available for pinned readers/replay until safely reclaimable
latent activation has no authority and may be reset/rebuilt without altering canonical history
Assembly must record graph_epoch, activation_epoch and CognitiveFrame witness
compaction/rebuild decisions use measured update+query+memory workload, not a fixed delta threshold
retrieval/activation gains never authorize physical store merger
rollback: switch reader routing to prior known-good semantic epoch or direct authoritative stores; discard/rebuild latent activation; replay authoritative events through projector; verify provenance/status hashes before re-enable
promotion_gates: crash during delta build and publish
